title: Necessary and Sufficient Criteria for the Realizability of Kaleidocycles Composed of Six Congruent Isosceles Tetrahedra
summary: A classical kaleidocycle is a closed cyclic chain of congruent, edge-hinged tetrahedra with successive hinge axes at right angles, capable of continuous inside-out motion. Kaleidocycles composed of six isosceles tetrahedra (disphenoids) form a natural generalization in which consecutive hinge axes need not be perpendicular. Their kinematics are governed by the closure equation for threefold-symmetric Bricard 6R linkages. We derive a new compact closure equation directly from threefold symmetry using the composition of rotations, and show its equivalence to the classical formulation.…
